falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% above its latest close within 14 calendar days and finishes the window above its 20-day high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout invalidates both HOLD and the mini_top_2019_jun analog; the tape was a continuation, so UNKNOWN should have resolved to risk-on

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6% below its latest close, or VIX closes above 30, within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A realized risk-off move of that size invalidates HOLD/UNKNOWN; the mini-top was already in and the correct signal was defensive, not wait-and-see

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 75 basis points or more from its latest reading within 14 calendar days while the blowoff score stays at or below 57
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit stress of that magnitude without a blowoff reading shows the 76% mini-top match mis-specified the regime; UNKNOWN/HOLD failed to flag an already-breaking credit market

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
